title: Keep authorized Evolution history readable when approval enrichment is forbidden

hosted_incident_evidence.root_cause: During page_items mutation-review hydration in services/control-plane/bff/evolution/router.py, _mutation_review_projection -> GovernanceService.mutation_review_projection -> ReadSurfacePorts.get_approval_decision fell back to ManagementReviewQueuePort._approval_decisions_reader after by_id_reader failed, re-raising the request-cached Governance approval owner HTTP 403 ('Approval read role required' on GET /api/governance/approvals) uncaught as an HTTP 500 for tenant-scoped viewers.

sanitized_artifacts.summary: Dev BFF traceback showing urllib.error.HTTPError 403 Forbidden from http://governance:8000/api/governance/approvals escaping _mutation_review_projection during evolution journal page hydration.

Evolution owner GET /api/evolution/proposals returned HTTP 200 (2838 rows, 83 history-eligible) while Governance owner GET /api/governance/approvals returned HTTP 403 ('Approval read role required') for viewer and HTTP 200 (699 rows) for operator.
BFF GET /bff/management/evolution-journal?view=history&page_size=20 returned HTTP 500 for viewer and HTTP 200 (returned: 20, total: 88, approval_decisions: ok, mutation_review: ok) for operator.

changes.summary: Added _is_approval_forbidden_error and _JournalApprovalIsolatedReadStore, and wired bff_management_evolution_journal to pass read_surface=journal_read_store into the existing single typed mutation_review_projection (_mutation_review_projection -> GovernanceService.mutation_review_projection). Confined 403 conversion strictly to the optional Governance approval-owner read boundary (get_approval_decision / get_approval_decision_by_id / approval dataset_source) without inspect.signature branching, duplicate GovernanceService projection routes, or request_read_cache internal scanning. When approval enrichment is forbidden (HTTP 403), GovernanceService.mutation_review_projection projects approval_decision=None, all allowedActions=False, and nested mutation_review surface status 'unavailable' for review-Required decision states while top-level meta.surfaces reports approval_decisions='unavailable', mutation_review='degraded', and management_evolution_journal='ok'.

Added test_journal_viewer_reads_history_when_governance_owner_forbids_approvals_while_operator_receives_enrichment (exercising real Governance owner FastAPI routes, JWT role enforcement, ReadSurfacePorts, and _mutation_review_projection for viewer 403 isolation, pagination, zero protected approval leakage, operator full enrichment, and unauthorized/cross-tenant/write refusal) and test_journal_isolates_store_level_approval_403_and_propagates_non_403_errors (verifying store-level 403 isolation, non-403 approval error propagation, and unrelated projection error propagation even when a 403 is cached in request_read_cache).

Recorded the Dev Root 44952879415 viewer HTTP 500 incident under RC6 WP6.4 linked to BFF-EVOLUTION-JOURNAL-APPROVAL-READ-ISOLATION-20261121, retaining hosted verification with EVOLUTION-RESEARCH-HOSTED-ACCEPT-20261104 and MGMT-GATE-FULL-PASS-HOSTED-ACCEPTANCE-20261114.

acceptance_criteria_verification.ac1_viewer_history_readable_on_approval_: Verified in test_journal_viewer_reads_history_when_governance_owner_forbids_approvals_while_operator_receives_enrichment: viewer receives HTTP 200 with all 8 history items, preserved base records, evidence_class classification, multi-page pagination, meta.surfaces.approval_decisions.status=='unavailable', meta.surfaces.mutation_review.status=='degraded', meta.surfaces.management_evolution_journal.status=='ok', mutation_review.approval_decision is None, allowedActions all False, and no protected approval rationale or actor strings in response.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac2_operator_enrichment_and_owner_bounda: Verified in test_journal_viewer_reads_history_when_governance_owner_forbids_approvals_while_operator_receives_enrichment: authorized operator receives HTTP 200 with meta.surfaces.approval_decisions.status=='ok', meta.surfaces.mutation_review.status=='ok', populated mutation_review.approval_decision and allowedActions, while direct Governance owner viewer reads/writes return 403, foreign-tenant approval reads return 404, unauthenticated journal reads return 401, cross-tenant viewer journal reads return 403 TENANT_MISMATCH, and viewer writes return 403.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac3_focused_coverage_register_entry_and_: Added focused tests in services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_bff_b3_evolution_journal.py, recorded RC6 WP6.4 row in docs/operations/problem-register.md, and retained hosted acceptance verification with EVOLUTION-RESEARCH-HOSTED-ACCEPT-20261104 and MGMT-GATE-FULL-PASS-HOSTED-ACCEPTANCE-20261114.

runtime_budget.note: Request-scoped read isolation only; adds no recurring jobs, emitters, or persistent writers.
